column1:
Showers may occur at several places in the sea areas off the coast extending from Chilaw to Galle via
Colombo.

Winds will be south-westerly. Wind speed will be (30-40) kmph. Wind speed can increase up to (55-65)
kmph at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from Kankasanthurai to Puttalam via Mannar
and from, Matara to Pottuvil via Hambantota. Wind speed can increase up to 50 kmph at times in the
other sea areas around the island.

The sea areas off the coasts extending from Kankasanthurai to Puttalam via Mannar and from, Matara
to Pottuvil via Hambantota will be very rough at times. The other sea areas around the island will be
fairly rough at times.
The wave height may increase about (2.0 – 2.5) meters in the sea areas off the coast extending from
Chilaw to Pottuvil via Colombo, Galle and Hambantota.
